Pre-flight

What we check before you sign.

LON · PRE-FLIGHT · WHAT WE CHECK

01 Tenant Fees Act 2019 Who may charge you

The landlord's side can take rent, capped deposits and a few set charges, not letting fees. We are hired by you, paid by you, and never act for the landlord.

02 Renters' Rights Act 2025 Rent in advance

On most new tenancies: no rent before you sign, and at most one month's rent between signing and the start. Months upfront no longer replace a guarantor.

03 no bidding One asking rent

Landlords and agents must advertise one rent and may not invite or accept offers above it. A request to outbid is a breach, not a tactic.

04 5 weeks' rent The deposit

Five weeks' rent at most, six on the highest rents; a holding deposit, one week's. Within 30 days the landlord lodges it in a government-approved scheme (DPS, TDS or mydeposits) and sends you its details. We tell you what to ask for.

05 periodic since 1 May 2026 The tenancy

On most private tenancies there is no fixed term: you can leave with two months' notice. A sale or a landlord moving in normally cannot end it in the first 12 months.

06 eVisa · share code Right to Rent

Every adult is checked before the start; eVisa holders give a share code. With time-limited permission the check comes no earlier than 28 days before the start, so a tenancy can be agreed in principle before you fly. We plan around it.

    Before you ask

    Questions.

    01 Can a London agent charge me fees?

    Not letting fees, if they act for the landlord: under the Tenant Fees Act 2019 the landlord's side can take rent, capped deposits and a few set charges. That agent is paid by the landlord and works for the landlord. BOOM London is a separate agent you hire: a flat fee, paid by you only, and we never act for any landlord.

    02 What happens on the free call?

    A call with Valentino, by phone or WhatsApp, at a time that suits you both. We hear your dates, budget and who is moving, say which service fits, or that none does, and which papers you are missing. Nothing is charged for the call. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call.

    03 I have no UK guarantor. Can I still rent?

    London landlords usually want a UK-based guarantor; family abroad is generally not accepted. Without one, many tenants use a paid guarantor service. Paying months upfront no longer replaces it: on most new tenancies, no rent before signing, and at most one month's rent between signing and the start. Application Pack sets the strategy with your papers.

    04 How do I avoid a rental scam in London from abroad?

    Never pay a holding deposit or rent for a home nobody on your side has seen. Fake listings use stolen photos, or holiday lets staged as homes. With Attended Viewing (£149) a BOOM person visits it in your place, with live video and a written report. With Full Search or Application Pack we also check the tenancy before you sign.

    05 What if you don't find anything?

    We tell you in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market; if BOOM declines the search then, the £500 Full Search fee is refunded in full. Once we take it on, the search runs until you sign or stop it, and the fee pays for the work, not for a result.
